title: Docs
subtitle: Clear explanations, definitions, and boundaries. No hype language.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.body: PonyLife is not an investment platform. It does not offer returns, guarantees, or financial promises. Participation is voluntary and uncertain.

sections.heading: Glossary
sections.body: Coordination: aligning independent actions. Participation: voluntary involvement without guaranteed outcomes. Outcome: externally observable result.

sections.heading: Terms & privacy
sections.body: Terms and privacy policies are provided for transparency and clarity. The MVP uses minimal data collection.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions or submissions, use the contact page or linked channels.
